mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% triggers a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a low unemployment rate and a strong increase in payroll employment signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production growth rate below -2% signals a supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when industrial production growth rate is below -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a low federal funds rate and a strong increase in GDP growth rate signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during monetary easing cycles (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6% triggers a labor market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during late-cycle contractions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decline in industrial production growth rate and a strong increase in CPI growth rate signals a supply chain disruption and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when industrial production growth rate is below -2% and CPI growth rate is above 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
